integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard forcing semantics and the Delta-system lemma. The finite checker validates only cross-petal bookkeeping and is not evidence for the infinite forcing step.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the finite-condition Cohen-generic construction of a single symmetric relation on an uncountable set. It does not claim later-forcing absoluteness. The literature search cannot exclude an unpublished or unindexed proof of the same conjecture.
title: Every uncountable Cohen-generic symmetric relation is rigid
